subject: Harmonized offer: consolidated pricing & bundle options for EmberAI
messages:
From: Jared Cole <jared.cole@emberai.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@emberai.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 21:12:00 +0000
Subject: Consolidated pricing for multi-product rollout

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking the call last week. Ember is evaluating a single vendor to cover hosted inference for our customer-facing chat product + an internal embeddings backbone. A few things we need to compare across proposals: blended per-token economics, a simple bundle for dev/prod capacity, and one-off migration/onboarding credits.

We received a competing proposal that offers a 10% usage credit in year one plus an additional 6 months of free pilot access if we commit to a 24-month reserved pool. Before we loop procurement, can you send a single-sheet "harmonized" offer that shows:
- 12/24/36-month committed price tiers (hosted vs dedicated pool)
- explicit onboarding credit or migration assistance (USD amount)
- any packaging discounts for combined generations + embeddings usage
- terms around model fallbacks and SLA credits

Appreciate something concise we can present to finance and procurement.

Jared
Director, Platform Engineering
EmberAI

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@emberai.com>
Cc: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@emberai.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Consolidated pricing for multi-product rollout

Jared — thanks, forwarding a concise harmonized proposal attached. High level summary below; full breakdown is in the attached PDF.

Summary (attached: Redwood-Harmonized-Offer-v1.pdf):
- Blended committed rates: 0–3M tokens/month: $0.0017/tx; 3–15M: $0.0012/tx; 15M+: $0.00095/tx (generation + embeddings blended by usage mix).
- Commitment terms: 12/24/36 mo shows nominal step discounts of 6%/11%/16% vs pay-as-you-go on equivalent spend.
- Onboarding credit: $75k one-time credit applied to first invoice for migrations + runbook support; additional migration engineering at standard scoped SOW (attached draft).
- Bundle credit: additional 5% off on combined generation+embedding usage when both routes are in the same billing account (applies to committed spend).
- SLA/fallback: 99.9% regional availability SLA with an automatic fallback to a compatible quantized variant; SLA credits table in PDF.

Notes:
- We can convert the onboarding credit into equivalent first-year usage credit if procurement prefers a TCO-style line item.
- We left room on term/credit sizing if Ember shares target committed spend.

Attachments: Redwood-Harmonized-Offer-v1.pdf, SOW-EmberAI-draft.docx

Happy to walk through this in 30 min tomorrow if you want to go line-by-line.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0189

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Jared Cole <jared.cole@emberai.com>, Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@emberai.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 14:30:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Harmonized offer: consolidated pricing & bundle options for EmberAI

Mina / team — quick internal note before we finalize:

- Finance check: if Ember is targeting ~18M tokens/mo blended in year 1, we can tighten the top tier to $0.00088/tx for a 24-month commit and move the onboarding credit to $100k. That preserves ~8% net margin vs current list.
- Packaging: propose adding a limited 3-month pilot window (hosted) with a negotiated burst pool for ramp. Keeps the competitive pilot offer but controlled.
- Legal: add explicit data-retention language (customer-managed retention TTL on embeddings) — Ember had flagged compliance on the initial call.

If that sounds right, Mina — can you push an option B with the 24-mo/100k credit & pilot window. We should surface the price waterfall (list -> committed -> bundle -> onboarding-credit) as a single slide so procurement can see delta vs competitor.

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Jared Cole <jared.cole@emberai.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@emberai.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Harmonized offer: consolidated pricing & bundle options for EmberAI

Thanks — we reviewed with procurement. A few pushbacks and asks:

1) The competitor's 10% usage credit is applied throughout year one, not just onboarding. Can Redwood match a run-rate credit rather than a one-time migration credit?
2) Ember prefers a 15-month commitment option (not typical, I know) — gives our board alignment. Can we model 15-mo blended pricing or is that a hard no?
3) Clarify the pilot: competitor offers 6 months free pilot hardware access; we'd accept 3 months free hosted pilot + guaranteed 50% off burst credit for months 4–6.

Procurement also asked for a simple TCO line showing net-first-year cash impact (credits, discounts) vs competitor. Can you provide a short comparison table?

If we can get closer on credit structure (run-rate vs one-time) and tighten the 24-mo offer, we can move to redlines next week.

-Jared

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@emberai.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@emberai.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Harmonized offer: consolidated pricing & bundle options for EmberAI

Jared — appreciate the clear asks. We want Ember as a marquee customer; below is a revised, pragmatic counter that mirrors the competitor while protecting commitment economics. Updated PDF attached; summary below.

Counter (high level):
- Credit structure: convert onboarding $75k -> $60k onboarding credit + an additional 7% run-rate usage credit applied to monthly invoices in year 1 (capped to committed spend). Net-first-year effect modeled in the attached comparison.
- Term flexibility: offer a 15-month custom term at the 24-month price tier (i.e., you get the 24-mo discount applied pro rata over 15 months) — gives the board the cadence they want without committing to 24 months.
- Pilot: 3 months free hosted pilot + months 4–6 at 50% burst credit (as requested).
- Additional: $25k professional services credit to help with embeddings migration mapping (applied to SOW).

Next steps: I'll upload a two-column TCO table (Redwood vs competitor) to the HubSpot deal record and send a DocuSign-ready SOW if Ember wants to proceed. Would you be open to a 30-minute exec-level check (LA morning / NY afternoon) Friday to finalize the commercials?

Thanks — Mina
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
Attachments: Redwood-Harmonized-Offer-v1.pdf (updated), SOW-EmberAI-draft.docx
